  • 10 Септември 2026 г.
Realising the potential of the EU’s outermost regions

A new Commission strategy will ensure that the EU’s outermost regions can fully realise their potential, with stronger support, greater resilience and fairer opportunities for their people. From Martinique to Madeira, the EU’s outermost regions play a key geostrategic role in today’s changing world.

Време за четене 1 мин
  • Press release
  • 9 Септември 2026 г.
New EU rules to help local authorities tackle the housing crisis

New EU rules have been proposed to support EU countries and cities address the affordable housing crisis, particularly housing used for purposes other than primary residence. The rules give public authorities the legal certainty when they choose to act, based on local specificities, within EU law.

Време за четене 1 мин

  • 9 Септември 2026 г.
European Heritage Days 2026: protecting Europe’s heritage at risk

Throughout September and October, the European Heritage Days 2026 invites people across Europe, under the theme “heritage at risk: revive, resist, reimagine” to discover how communities are protecting, restoring and reimagining their heritage for the future. Find out more.

Факти и цифри за Европейския съюз

Научете колко са държавите в Европейския съюз, какъв е размерът на неговата икономика, как живеят хората в ЕС и други полезни факти за Съюза.

Постижения

Realising the potential of the EU’s outermost regions

A new Commission strategy will ensure that the EU’s outermost regions can fully realise their potential, with stronger support, greater resilience and fairer opportunities for their people. From Martinique to Madeira, the EU’s outermost regions play a key geostrategic role in today’s changing world.

1 min læsetid
  • Press release
  • 9. september 2026
New EU rules to help local authorities tackle the housing crisis

New EU rules have been proposed to support EU countries and cities address the affordable housing crisis, particularly housing used for purposes other than primary residence. The rules give public authorities the legal certainty when they choose to act, based on local specificities, within EU law.

1 min læsetid
  • Press release
  • 9. september 2026
European Heritage Days 2026: protecting Europe’s heritage at risk

Throughout September and October, the European Heritage Days 2026 invites people across Europe, under the theme “heritage at risk: revive, resist, reimagine” to discover how communities are protecting, restoring and reimagining their heritage for the future. Find out more.
